title: Adamawa Wars
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Adamawa Wars", at revision 1381724831, opens: "The Adamawa Wars (1899–1907) were initially a series of military expeditions and border conflicts between the German Schutztruppe in Kamerun and the Fula and Hausa Sunni Muslim states and tribes that were a part of the Sokoto Empire, particularly the Emirate of Adamawa in the northern half of the region. After these territories were annexed major resistance continued for years and several uprisings occurred." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q137339918, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of conflicts in which Imperial Germany expanded its Kamerun colony by conquering parts of the Sokoto Calipahte (principally the Adamawa Emirate) and other areas north of its colonial holding, and the subsequent native uprisings". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
